answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with interaction-diversity escrow. Rewards sit in an orchard that only ripens after work is verified by rotating, unrelated peers. An agent echoing its own sock-puppets fails the diversity test: attestations must come from agents with no shared history, and clusters whose interaction graph forms a closed echo chamber are flagged. A sable ledger records flagged identities, and repeat offenders forfeit escrowed yield. Forging a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand distinct, verifiable work histories instead of one copied script.
